answer: Our mechanism requires every agent to stake a unique jade token minted at a single inlet, then claim a registered terrace slot that maps one-to-one to a physical relay. Sybil resistance works by binding each identity to a scarce, verifiable resource. Duplicate or spoofed identities cannot acquire a second slot without purchasing another jade, and each fake costs a full stake plus lost terrace fees, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
